mentions.title: What's behind Alonso's cryptic comments about his F1 future?
mentions.summary:
Every Thursday, the media day in the paddock begins with a roundtable session with Mike Krack and Honda's chief engineer Shintaro Orihara. Besides the usual questions about power unit driveability and potential upgrades, one topic returns every race weekend: when can we expect an announcement about Fernando Alonso’s future?

mentions.title: Russell set to take F1 engine penalty after Mercedes introduces power unit upgrade
mentions.summary:
George Russell says he will take an engine penalty when Mercedes introduces its upgraded Formula 1 power unit.

mentions.summary:
Williams Formula 1 team principal James Vowles has admitted that the team's remaining 2026 upgrades will not be enough to consistently fight for points.
The Grove outfit has struggled since the beginning of the 2026 season. It arrived at pre-season testing in Bahrain with an overweight car, and it has only picked up 11 points in 14 rounds.
